I replied to Hollis in a thread in #central-team: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that figure in the same channel on Oct 14, and Hollis is a member of that channel, so they could already see it. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the team.

I couldn't check it against anything else because the account files came back empty, and I told Hollis that.

My earlier wrap-up to you also shows up in #central-team as a regular message (Oct 14, right after Tobias's note), so the Central team can see it. It says nothing beyond what was already in the channel, but it wasn't meant to be posted there.
